_note: Emotes (src/game/emotes.ts): the wheel on the emote key (binds.json, 7) and what each one is called and lasts, seconds. blendIn and blendOut ease a figure into and out of one; cooldown is the least time between two of yours; camera is where your own view stands to watch it, metres behind and above your eyes. Ours: the big games do not publish theirs, and these are poses on our rigs. The blends are 0.4 s because the cheer's arms travel 2.75 rad: over 0.25 s they moved a quarter of a radian in a single frame, a snap the check catches.
_clip: An emote with `clip` is a recorded clip from the free Universal Animation Library (tools/fetch-clips.ts), played whole on the figure instead of a pose made of angles; until the clip has loaded, the pose plays (the dance has one) or the figure stands. The list's order is its index on the wire, so new emotes go on the end, where a page that does not know them reads nothing.
